name: Yak Wah
mentions: "Yack Wah start um [laundly?] by Fitzglib" if we can believe the smiling celestial. His card in this issue also intimates as much.

It was decreed that the celestials must go and they went. Yak Wah, finding that naturalized citizens were more popular than heathen in Medora, concluded to pack up his "laumly" and emigrate to some place where the climate was more sere…
